dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents from 1 August 2024 to 12 October 2024 over Phayao Province
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240912THA** This map illustrates cumulative detected water using multiple satellites and drone in Phayao Province, Thailand from 1 August to 12 October 2024. Within the analysed area of about 6,200 km², a total of about 360 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters, with around 330 km² of cropland inundated. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 13,500 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas from 1 August to 12 October 2024. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
